thread_text:
Maya D: Quick sync  I want to propose a very small, testable launch slice for private deployments. Goal: let customers choose egress wiring presets, validate routing before commit, and run a canary+drain upgrade that can roll back quickly. Thoughts?

Samir K: Love the narrow scope. Suggest 3 presets only: `nat-relay`, `bgp-peer`, `preserve-egress-ip`. Covers most field asks.

Elaine R: +1. Also add `managed-nat` for strict firewall customers. Callout: preserve-egress-ip requires a validated public IP and documented routing steps from their net team.

Noah P: From infra side, we need an opt-in dry-run mode that validates reachability and BGP acceptance without touching runtime state. `--egress-validate-only`?

Samir K: Exactly. Draft installer flags (minimal):
```
--egress-mode=nat-relay|bgp-peer|preserve-egress
--preserve-egress-ip=203.0.113.5/32
--bgp-asn=64512
--upgrade-canary=0.1
--drain-seconds=120
--egress-validate-only
```
Default to `nat-relay`.

Elaine R: Validation must check: IP ownership (no conflicts), upstream route acceptance (BGP origin), and that egress traffic matches expected IPs. If `preserve-egress` and IP is in use -> fail with clear message.

Maya D: Launch gating (proposal):
- Docs: quickstart + troubleshooting (ops & netops sections)
- Two pilots verified (BlueLeaf & QuantSafe) on both NAT and preserve flows
- Staging upgrade run: canary->full with rollback tested
- Telemetry: per-tenant egress IP metric, upgrade success/failure rate
- Security signoff for KMS/HSM if customers request

Noah P: For the canary upgrade flow I'll propose: canary subset, smoke tests, drain, then ramp. If smoke fails -> immediate rollback. Smoke tests: HTTP(S) e2e, egress IP match, control-plane reconnect.

Samir K: I'll add a small test harness that runs those smoke steps and emits a single pass/fail. Also include a `--force-rollback` trigger for operators.

Elaine R: Netops onboarding checklist (must-have): customer ASN, allowed prefix list, egress IP(s), peering contact window, emergency rollback contact. We'll include a short troubleshooter section (NAT timeouts, stateful firewalls).

Maya D: Field request: prioritize BlueLeaf (needs preserved IP + IP allowlisting) and QuantSafe (HSM + strict audit). Those push KMS/HSM docs earlier.

Samir K: Implementation notes: keep defaults safe (nat-relay), installer validates before applying, and no UI changes in phase 1. Phase 2 can add mapping in Console.

Noah P: infra-bot, create infra ticket to track `egress-validate-only` and smoke harness.

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-14356 created: "egress-validate-only + smoke harness for private-deploy pilot" assigned to @Noah P and @Samir K, due in 10d.

Maya D: Ownership: Elaine -> netops docs & onboarding template. Samir -> installer flags + harness. Noah -> infra validation & staging runs. I'll own pilot comms and launch criteria.

Elaine R: I'll start a customer onboarding template with fields for ASN, IPs, contact windows, and a small checklist for preflight ops.

Samir K: ETA: 2 sprints to get a pilot-ready PR and test harness. Will sync with Elaine on BGP checks.

Maya D: One more UX note: include a short failure message for operators when preserve IP validation fails: "EGRESS_IP_IN_USE or ROUTE_NOT_ACCEPTED". Keeps field handoffs fast.

Noah P: Agreed. Also recommend we capture telemetry: `egress_validation.status` and `upgrade.canary_outcome` for future analysis.

deploy-bot: Staging dry-run window scheduled: 2024-05-03T03:00:00Z.

Maya D: Thanks all. We'll keep the slice deliberately tight. If pilots go well we expand to more presets and console mapping in phase 2. Reconvene after the staging dry-run.
